title: Understanding SVD
text: In Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), the matrix S contains the singular values. These values are related to the variance captured by each principal component. The larger the singular value, the more variance that component captures.

title: Calculating Total Variance
text: To find the total variance, sum the squares of the singular values in the matrix S. This will give you the total variance captured by all principal components.

title: Finding Total Variance
text: What is the total variance captured by all principal components?

title: Proportion of Variance for PC1
text: The proportion of variance captured by PC1 is the square of the first singular value divided by the total variance. Use the singular value from the first row of S.

title: Calculating Proportion for PC1
text: What is the proportion of the total variance captured by PC1?
